title: Algorithms
info: An algorithm is a list of steps that finishes a job.
Order matters. If you put on shoes before socks, the steps are in a poor order.
A computer follows steps exactly, so clear steps matter.

options: A list of steps to finish a job
Some steps must come before others
Follow the steps it is given
Fix a silly order by feelings
Shoes, then socks on the outside
